photo.title: Roma tomatoes (509115549)

description: A sweet-pepper group producing mild, fleshy fruits. Colour and size vary with the variety and ripeness.
sunlightInstructions: Choose a sunny growing site; shelter and seasonal conditions matter. Follow the growing notes for this crop.
wateringInstructions: Keep soil evenly moist with good drainage; avoid letting containers dry completely.
fertilizingInstructions: Base feeding on soil or container needs and a suitable product label. Do not feed automatically during dormancy.
soilInstructions: Use fertile, well-drained soil in a warm position or a drained container.
humidityInstructions: Provide air circulation and check outdoor weather or greenhouse conditions. Avoid leaving roots waterlogged.

catalogProfile.growingNotes: Grow in full sun with shelter and warmth. In cool climates a greenhouse or protected sunny spot can help. Move outside after frost risk has passed.
catalogProfile.harvestInstructions: Cut fruits from the stem. Green fruits can be harvested before they develop their variety's mature colour.

description: A group of hot peppers grown for pungent fruits. Heat and fruit shape vary; do not assume an ornamental pepper is a culinary variety.
sunlightInstructions: Choose a sunny growing site; shelter and seasonal conditions matter. Follow the growing notes for this crop.
wateringInstructions: Water when the surface starts to dry, keeping the root zone moist with good drainage.
fertilizingInstructions: Base feeding on soil or container needs and a suitable product label. Do not feed automatically during dormancy.
soilInstructions: Use fertile, freely draining soil or a container with drainage holes.
humidityInstructions: Provide air circulation and check outdoor weather or greenhouse conditions. Avoid leaving roots waterlogged.

catalogProfile.growingNotes: Provide full sun, warmth and protection from frost. Choose a culinary variety from a labelled seed or nursery source.
catalogProfile.harvestInstructions: Cut usable fruits at the stage specified for the variety. Hot fruits can irritate skin and eyes; handle carefully.

description: A compact hot-pepper cultivar. It belongs to the same species as many sweet peppers, rather than being a separate species.
sunlightInstructions: Choose a sunny growing site; shelter and seasonal conditions matter. Follow the growing notes for this crop.
wateringInstructions: Keep the soil moist but drained; check container moisture more often in warm weather.
fertilizingInstructions: Base feeding on soil or container needs and a suitable product label. Do not feed automatically during dormancy.
soilInstructions: Use fertile, freely draining growing mix in a drained pot or garden bed.
humidityInstructions: Provide air circulation and check outdoor weather or greenhouse conditions. Avoid leaving roots waterlogged.

catalogProfile.growingNotes: Provide full sun and shelter after frost risk has passed.
catalogProfile.harvestInstructions: Cut fruits rather than pulling them from branches. Handle hot peppers carefully and avoid touching your eyes.

description: A deciduous fruit tree or shrub. Choose a locally suitable fruiting cultivar; plant sap and foliage can cause irritation.
sunlightInstructions: Choose a sunny growing site; shelter and seasonal conditions matter. Follow the growing notes for this crop.
wateringInstructions: Check the root zone and water during dry spells, especially while establishing or growing in a pot. Reduce checks during dormancy.
fertilizingInstructions: Base feeding on soil or container needs and a suitable product label. Do not feed automatically during dormancy.
soilInstructions: Use organically rich, moist but well-drained soil; containers need drainage.
humidityInstructions: Provide air circulation and check outdoor weather or greenhouse conditions. Avoid leaving roots waterlogged.

catalogProfile.growingNotes: Choose a sunny, sheltered site. Container roots need winter protection; check the cultivar's hardiness rather than assuming every fig tolerates the same frost.
catalogProfile.harvestInstructions: Pick soft, ripe fruit. Protect skin from sap and keep foliage away from pets.

description: A deciduous fruit tree available on rootstocks that control its eventual size. Fruit colour, flavour and ripening time depend on the cultivar.
sunlightInstructions: Choose a sunny growing site; shelter and seasonal conditions matter. Follow the growing notes for this crop.
wateringInstructions: Water the root zone during dry periods while establishing. Check soil and rainfall rather than watering automatically.
fertilizingInstructions: Base feeding on soil or container needs and a suitable product label. Do not feed automatically during dormancy.
soilInstructions: Use fertile, well-drained soil with enough space for the chosen rootstock.
humidityInstructions: Provide air circulation and check outdoor weather or greenhouse conditions. Avoid leaving roots waterlogged.

catalogProfile.growingNotes: Choose a locally suited cultivar and rootstock. Most benefit from a compatible nearby apple flowering at the same time. Keep seeds, stems and leaves away from pets.
catalogProfile.harvestInstructions: Harvest as the cultivar ripens; apples should separate with a gentle lift and twist. Discard damaged fruit.

description: A deciduous tree grown for dessert or cooking pears. Rootstock, cultivar and pollination partner affect the space and crop required.
sunlightInstructions: Choose a sunny growing site; shelter and seasonal conditions matter. Follow the growing notes for this crop.
wateringInstructions: Check soil moisture and rainfall; water during establishment and prolonged dry periods.
fertilizingInstructions: Base feeding on soil or container needs and a suitable product label. Do not feed automatically during dormancy.
soilInstructions: Plant in deep, fertile, well-drained soil with room for the selected tree size.
humidityInstructions: Provide air circulation and check outdoor weather or greenhouse conditions. Avoid leaving roots waterlogged.

catalogProfile.growingNotes: Choose a sunny site and a cultivar suited to local conditions. Check whether a compatible pollination partner is needed before purchasing.
catalogProfile.harvestInstructions: Pick when mature but still firm and finish ripening off the tree, following guidance for the chosen cultivar.

description: A deciduous fruit tree with many plum and prune cultivars. Flowers, foliage and stones are not food; keep plant material away from pets.
sunlightInstructions: Choose a sunny growing site; shelter and seasonal conditions matter. Follow the growing notes for this crop.
wateringInstructions: Check the root zone and water during establishment or dry spells, avoiding saturated soil.
fertilizingInstructions: Base feeding on soil or container needs and a suitable product label. Do not feed automatically during dormancy.
soilInstructions: Use fertile, moist but well-drained soil and space for the mature tree.
humidityInstructions: Provide air circulation and check outdoor weather or greenhouse conditions. Avoid leaving roots waterlogged.

catalogProfile.growingNotes: Grow in a sunny site. Check the cultivar's pollination requirements and local pruning advice; self-fertility varies.
catalogProfile.harvestInstructions: Pick ripe, sound fruits. Remove stones before eating or processing; do not chew the stones.

description: A low-growing fruit crop with runners. Summer-bearing and repeat-fruiting cultivars have different cropping patterns.
sunlightInstructions: Choose a sunny growing site; shelter and seasonal conditions matter. Follow the growing notes for this crop.
wateringInstructions: Keep the soil consistently moist with drainage, watering the soil rather than soaking ripening fruits.
fertilizingInstructions: Base feeding on soil or container needs and a suitable product label. Do not feed automatically during dormancy.
soilInstructions: Use fertile, well-drained soil. Plant with the crown at the soil surface rather than burying it.
humidityInstructions: Provide air circulation and check outdoor weather or greenhouse conditions. Avoid leaving roots waterlogged.

catalogProfile.growingNotes: Provide sun and choose a cultivar suited to your intended harvest season. Allow room for runners or remove unwanted ones to manage the bed.
catalogProfile.harvestInstructions: Pick fully coloured ripe berries with a small piece of stalk. Remove damaged or mouldy fruit promptly.

description: A cane fruit with summer-fruiting and autumn-fruiting forms. The type determines which canes should be kept after cropping.
sunlightInstructions: Choose a sunny growing site; shelter and seasonal conditions matter. Follow the growing notes for this crop.
wateringInstructions: Keep the root zone moist with good drainage; check more frequently during fruit development and dry weather.
fertilizingInstructions: Base feeding on soil or container needs and a suitable product label. Do not feed automatically during dormancy.
soilInstructions: Use fertile, well-drained soil, with mulch kept away from the cane bases.
humidityInstructions: Provide air circulation and check outdoor weather or greenhouse conditions. Avoid leaving roots waterlogged.

catalogProfile.growingNotes: Choose a sunny site with support where needed. Confirm the fruiting type before pruning: summer and autumn forms need different treatment.
catalogProfile.harvestInstructions: Pick berries when fully coloured and they release easily from the core. Harvest regularly while fruit is ripe.

description: A deciduous berry shrub requiring acidic growing conditions. Cultivars differ in flowering time, size and climate needs.
sunlightInstructions: Choose a sunny growing site; shelter and seasonal conditions matter. Follow the growing notes for this crop.
wateringInstructions: Keep roots evenly moist with drainage; avoid allowing containers to dry completely.
fertilizingInstructions: Base feeding on soil or container needs and a suitable product label. Do not feed automatically during dormancy.
soilInstructions: Use acidic, organically rich, well-drained soil or an ericaceous container mix.
humidityInstructions: Provide air circulation and check outdoor weather or greenhouse conditions. Avoid leaving roots waterlogged.

catalogProfile.growingNotes: Choose a sunny to lightly shaded site. Check soil acidity first; a container can suit unsuitable garden soil. A compatible second cultivar can improve cropping.
catalogProfile.harvestInstructions: Allow berries to become fully blue and ripe before picking; colour change alone may precede full sweetness.

description: A cool-season leafy crop with loose-leaf, butterhead, romaine and crisphead forms. The photo shows the loose-leaf Salad Bowl form.
sunlightInstructions: Choose a sunny growing site; shelter and seasonal conditions matter. Follow the growing notes for this crop.
wateringInstructions: Keep the shallow root zone consistently moist, without waterlogging. Dry soil and heat encourage bolting.
fertilizingInstructions: Base feeding on soil or container needs and a suitable product label. Do not feed automatically during dormancy.
soilInstructions: Use fertile, moisture-retentive but well-drained soil or growing mix.
humidityInstructions: Provide air circulation and check outdoor weather or greenhouse conditions. Avoid leaving roots waterlogged.

catalogProfile.growingNotes: Choose a variety suited to the season. In hot weather some afternoon shade can help; stagger sowings for successive small harvests.
catalogProfile.harvestInstructions: Pick outer leaves of suitable loose-leaf forms or cut mature heads. Harvest before flowering reduces leaf quality.

description: A crisphead lettuce cultivar forming a tight, rounded head of pale green leaves. It is a lettuce cultivar, not a different plant species.
sunlightInstructions: Choose a sunny growing site; shelter and seasonal conditions matter. Follow the growing notes for this crop.
wateringInstructions: Keep the soil moist with free drainage. Check often during dry weather because the roots are shallow.
fertilizingInstructions: Base feeding on soil or container needs and a suitable product label. Do not feed automatically during dormancy.
soilInstructions: Use fertile, moisture-retentive, well-drained soil or a suitable container mix.
humidityInstructions: Provide air circulation and check outdoor weather or greenhouse conditions. Avoid leaving roots waterlogged.

catalogProfile.growingNotes: Provide sun and plan for a cool growing period. Use the seed packet and local weather to choose sowing dates rather than a fixed calendar promise.
catalogProfile.harvestInstructions: Cut a firm, developed head before it flowers. Wash leaves before use.
